invariants.text: Commercial expiration never proves no payment
A collectible known Session retains D-01 protection even after admissions cease
New commercial Attempts require all valid financial, commercial and deadline guards
Window expiration does not revoke previously enabled HTTP dispatch
Release requires conclusive financial closure and authorized Inventory transition
Subsequent attempts do not restart Inventory's initial 15-minute TTL
Confirmed paid fact remains valid after admission deadline expires
Admission deadline is not a maximum physical protected-stock hold
Effective policy/version cannot be retroactively reinterpreted
Stuck protected cases are observable, recoverable and assigned to escalation
A separate legitimate purchase is not automatically an old attempt
Operational timings cannot bypass exclusivity, reconciliation or idempotency

tests.scenario: Previous Session negatively closed; buyer requests inside eligibility window
tests.oracle: Admit only with every other financial and commercial guard valid
Reject new Session before enabling any collectible operation

tests.scenario: Relative open but global deadline expired
tests.oracle: Reject admission; do not treat this as provider negative evidence

tests.scenario: Global deadline expires while original Session still open
tests.oracle: Protect Inventory while old opportunity remains collectible

tests.scenario: New Attempt admission races commercial-close operation
tests.oracle: Single valid admission or sealed close; no orphan collectible Session

tests.scenario: Window expires when Payments is unavailable
tests.oracle: Persist close request, retain protected stock, escalate

tests.scenario: Provider proves a charge after admission deadline
UNKNOWN operation exceeds every commercial deadline
tests.oracle: Never release by time alone; reconcile and escalate

tests.scenario: Second attempt admitted on same Reservation
tests.oracle: No renewed initial TTL or unauthorized second reservation

tests.scenario: Old browser requests retry after Inventory legitimate release
Store retry-window configuration changes during active checkout
tests.oracle: Effective version and previously enabled operations remain stable

tests.scenario: Several checkouts appear linked to one buying intention
tests.oracle: Do not create duplicate holds for idempotent retries; do not merge arbitrary purchases

tests.scenario: Buyer legitimately makes another independent purchase
tests.oracle: Do not deny it solely because another checkout existed

tests.scenario: Deadline passes while Ordering→Payments message is pending
tests.oracle: No contradictory close or capacity release

tests.scenario: Worker restarts after marking deadline expired but before durable admission closure
tests.oracle: Resume close and reconcile prior enabled operations
Detect accountable incident and operational escalation

acceptedScope: Admission cutoff policy for new commercial attempts only; safe stock retention remains mandatory
